title: The on_request hook failed
support_note: A push no grant or working-set entry covers whole files one request for the whole push: internal/gitbroker/approval.go askForPush, which builds the About with pushAbout and the request with pushRequest (approvalauthority.go). The request is filed under a real brokerhook.Runner whose hook exits 1; the runner records hook_failure and hook_output on the request (brokerhook.go noteFailure), and `--json` prints them.
story: The user's notification hook cannot reach a notification daemon, so the request waits and the listing says the user may not have been notified.
